title: Warped Mooshrooms
description: This Fabric mod adds nether variations of the Mooshroom, and makes them spawn in warped and crimson forrests!
body:
# Warped Mooshrooms!
is a mod that adds two new mooshrooms!
They are more decorative then functional, they spawn in the nether and just walk around a little in there!
Even though this mod is mostly decorative, it requires to be ran on both server and client.
